title: findbrokenobjects
description: `findbrokenobjects` searches for broken objects, including unknown object classes and objects that failed to create for other reasons. A `bang` starts the search and reports results as messages that can be separated with `route not-found not-created`. With no argument it searches the entire running Pd instance; a nonnegative integer argument selects a search root, although the patch text does not fully document the numeric modes.
